start_here: Say to your AI: "Run tool:match-rows with left, right." Pair rows from two places that describe the same thing: a bank or card line and its receipt, both sides of a transfer between accounts, a payment and the invoices it paid, a statement line and a bookkeeping row, a calendar event and a timesheet entry.
